fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and civic criticism focused on state government and Dade County finances, including discussion of liquor licensing and pari-mutuel gambling revenues. Regular columns and society-style items (“Notebook,” “They Tell Me”) report on Miami and Miami Beach personalities, nightlife, and entertainment venues. Sports and racing coverage includes dog track notes and horse-racing-related items, alongside extensive local advertising for bars, clubs, restaurants, and services; also includes material on NRA/code compliance and business conditions in the Miami area.
